task: quality track, fix mode: high domain-rule defect in research/osrobot-pairprice (drone pilot time uncharged) plus its medium break-even defect

errors.what: My first crossings test asserted f(x)=0 at every crossing; the swap sawtooth has jump discontinuities where the cheaper side flips without a root. Changed the test (and the docstring) to assert a sign flip; jumps are legitimate break-evens.
Wrote README/post numbers from rounded published fits before the full rerun; one ratio moved (1.62 ha: 2.36 -> 2.35). Caught by diffing against the full run and fixed.

doc_friction.issue: The prompt describes only the sample round (step 1 'quality_audit.py sample'); the README's 'Four modes' says run 'mode' first, which here returned fix. Two layers, two procedures: the prompt should say to run 'mode' first.

'queue' listed the platform/agents toJson defect as open because its fix PR #14674 is open but waiting on control-plane approval, not recorded in fix_prs. Recording an open-but-held PR in fix_prs is what stops runs re-picking it; the README does not say whether an unmerged PR belongs in fix_prs.

deviations.why: Fix mode asks for the fix and its test; the defect's subject has four descendant projects that copy the same labour rule. Rerunning all four is beyond one run, so I added a quantified Limitations note to each README instead of fixing their models.
deviations.did: Limitations bullet in osrobot-pipeline, -sourcedprices, -deadline, -deadlineloss stating the omission and its size (18.9 USD/ha)
deviations.result: Their headline claims are now visibly conditional; the reruns remain open work.

deviations.why: Main was red on check_storage_guard for an unrelated venture (texas-electricity-plan-checker), blocking every PR. No open PR fixed it, and the fix is small.
deviations.did: Fixed it in this PR as a separate commit rather than a separate PR.
deviations.result: Superseded: main fixed it first in PR #15737; this PR took main's version at merge.

notes: Mode: fix (quality_audit.py mode; 7 high defects open). No seed drawn (fix mode). Subjects: research/osrobot-pairprice (fixed: pilot paid by default, every break-even crossing reported, cost_model tested; full 15-min rerun, Sweeps 1-2 byte-identical, headline reversed from 'pair cheaper above 0.54 ha' to '2.3-2.6x dearer, no break-even at any scout price'), platform/agents (already fixed by open control-plane PR #14674; recorded in its audit fix_prs). Share meeting the bar: n/a (no audit round). Fix PRs: #15746 (this), #14674 (recorded). Mutations against the new tests: 3 of 3 caught (PILOT_ATTENDED off; sign-change scan disabled; swap minutes double-counted). Verification: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -> 16 OK; run.py --from-fits reproduces Sweeps 3-6 of the full run exactly; quality_audit.py validate -> 346 files, 0 problems; check_post_frontmatter/links/similarity pass. Local CI (run_workflow_locally --for-changes): 7 of 11 workflows passed locally before the long site-builder test was detached; real CI got runners. CI 'validate' failed on main itself: PR #15740 (storage guard) and PR #15739 (texas-electricity-plan-checker) landed minutes apart, so the new checker passed bare localStorage to its usage module. I fixed it here too, but main fixed it first (in PR #15737); at merge time I took main's version of the venture, so this PR does not change it. After the merge: check_storage_guard exit 0, node --test 29/29.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a research engineer: read the model, add pilot charging + root scan, rerun, rewrite README and four downstream notes, write post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
